summary: Idaho Power Company filed an 8-K on August 3, 2026, reporting the execution of a Terms Agreement to issue $200 million in 5.70% First Mortgage Bonds due 2055, Secured Medium-Term Notes, Series O, with an expected issuance date of August 6, 2026. The new bonds are an additional issuance consolidating with $400 million of prior outstanding bonds, bringing the aggregate to $600 million. Purchasers include J.P. Morgan, Mizuho, MUFG, Wells Fargo, BofA, Morgan Stanley, and U.S. Bancorp. This is a routine debt financing under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation.
